source.text: Two millimeters more around the cards.
Moss Market first commercial print order: 300 copies. Finalize the base-game tray, approve proofs and receive the finished cartons under this job.
Night-market expansion is an independent Moss Market prototype. Test whether after-dark trading adds useful choices; do not include these cards in the first print order.
Desk lamp photo description: cord insulation split at the base grommet. Keep the lamp unplugged while replacing its lead.
My two-millimeter note was about card clearance in the base-game tray for Moss Market's first 300-copy print job. It did not concern expansion cards.

events.reason: c05 identifies the dimension as first-print base-game tray clearance. Assign my fragment to that print job.

events.text: Two millimeters more clearance around the cards in the first-print Moss Market base-game tray.

source.text: First-print tray proof test: sleeved base-game cards lift out without bending after the extra clearance. The token wells still hold their contents when tilted.
Night-market expansion playtest report: bidding after dark slowed the final round. Revise the prototype's turn limit before another independent test.
Retailer has separately commissioned a 500-copy Moss Market reprint, with its own invoice and shipment. Planning can start now; manufacturing waits for the first job to close.
Printer account statement: deposit and balance for Moss Market's first 300-copy order; separate deposit for the retailer's 500-copy reprint. Do not combine the shipments.

events.text: Confirmed in the first-print Moss Market tray proof: two millimeters extra clearance around the sleeved base-game cards is sufficient.

source.text: Delivery docket: all 300 Moss Market first-run copies received, tray proof accepted, no carton damage. First manufacturing job closed.
Retailer reprint stock quote: 500 Moss Market boxes using the accepted base-game tray specification; offer thicker cover paper for this second order only.
Second night-market prototype session: the shorter turn limit worked, but the group wants clearer bidding icons. Keep this result with expansion research, not either print order.
